description: First hardware measurement campaign for larger Grover-Rudolph state-preparation distributions. This campaign measures the prepared distribution only; it does not run QAE amplification.
rationale: Phase 0-GR exact statevector checks gave total variation distance at numerical roundoff.
The ibm_fez transpilation audit kept all selected circuits below depth and two-qubit-gate thresholds.
Distribution measurement should precede QAE amplification for larger Grover-Rudolph loaders.

selected_cases.label: sin2(pi x), 8 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Lowest-cost n=3 Grover-Rudolph distribution candidate from Phase 0-GR.

deferred_cases.reason: Viable by depth and two-qubit count, but slightly more sensitive in the noisy TVD audit.

stopping_rules: Do not add QAE amplification until measured distribution TVD has been reviewed.
Pause if the n=3 circuits show TVD substantially above the noisy simulation readout.
Rerun Phase 0-GR if backend calibration or queue status changes substantially before submission.
